description: This file defines the 'ModifySubject' class, which is an immutable Java class implementing command logic for modifying a 'Subject' within the Eclipse Ditto policy framework. It includes methods for creating instances, parsing from JSON, and retrieving command details, as well as defining relevant fields and resource paths.

classes.name: ModifySubject
classes.description: An immutable command class representing an operation to modify a Subject within a policy entry, including methods for creation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and accessing command properties.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods to create instances of ModifySubject from parameters or JSON.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static methods to deserialize a ModifySubject command from JSON string or object.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the policy entry.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns the subject to be modified.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the policy related to this command.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of the subject to be modified, version-specific.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Constructs and returns the JSON pointer path for the resource affected by this command.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Builds the JSON payload for the command, conditioned on schema version and predicate.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns that this command is a modification category.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new instance with specified Ditto headers.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Hash code generation based on fields.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: String representation of the command instance.
